note: What a server sends to lay out everything a champion carries: its items, its summoner slots, the choices made before the match, and what it looks like.

fields.name: items
fields.note: The items the champion may hold, by the numbers the client knows them as. Zero where a place holds none.

fields.name: summoners
fields.note: The spells in the champion's summoner slots.

fields.name: summonersAgain
fields.note: The same two spells a second time. A server writes them twice and both runs agree in everything observed.

fields.name: choices
fields.note: The choices made before the match, one place each. A place stands empty where nothing was chosen.

fields.name: level
fields.note: The level the champion starts at.

fields.name: wardSkin
fields.note: What the champion's wards look like.
